Discourse LetterAvatar: ImageMagick before vs Vips after

A pixel comparison of the production ImageMagick implementation on origin/main against the low-risk Vips implementation. Changed pixels are magenta in each diff; matching pixels are dimmed.

Both sides were generated in the same published discourse/base:2.0.20260731-0206@sha256:55d36eeb4d12f5b2dd01c9b0dad8293fe11af8d7b1755ad3d930e35bbccd5280 image with each commit’s production generation and resize commands.

Meaningful production sizes

Default configured sizes: 24, 48, 72, 96, 144, 288. Explicit core call-site sizes: 25, 40, 45, 90, 120. Internal master and request clamp: 360.

Custom avatar_sizes values and arbitrary controller URL sizes are possible, so no finite report can enumerate site-specific or manually requested values. This report covers every default configured output, every explicit numeric core call site, and the master size.
